mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification ( EMAIL_CHECK, IS_VERIFIED, VERIFICATION_CODE, EXPIRED_AT ) VALUES ( #{emailCheck}, 'N', #{verificationCode}, #{expiredAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE VERIFICATION_CODE = #{verificationCode}, EXPIRED_AT = #{expiredAt}, IS_VERIFIED = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM email_verification WHERE EMAIL_CHECK = #{email} AND IS_VERIFIED = 'Y'
SELECT VERIFICATION_ID, EMAIL_CHECK, IS_VERIFIED, VERIFICATION_CODE, EXPIRED_AT FROM email_verification WHERE EMAIL_CHECK = #{email} ORDER BY VERIFICATION_ID DESC LIMIT 1
